prayerExcerpt.en-US: Faithful to Christ the King even to the point of martyrdom.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Fiéis a Cristo até o martírio.

meta.face: Christopher (left): a Mexican mestizo man of about fifty-eight with a warm brown complexion and a broad, full, square-jawed face — a wide forehead, thick, wavy black hair greying a little, combed up and back in a wave, a broad nose with a rounded tip, heavy-lidded dark eyes under thick, straight black brows, full cheeks, full lips, clean-shaven; a calm, serious, fatherly gaze toward the viewer. Agustín (right): a slim young man of about twenty-nine with a light-brown complexion and a narrow oval face — thick, dark hair cut short and parted at the side, a straight, slender nose, dark eyes under straight, level brows, ears set out a little, a small mouth and a narrow chin, clean-shaven; a gentle, earnest gaze. The two must look clearly different in age and build.
meta.basis: Studio photographs of both priests survive: Magallanes, parish priest of Totatiche, broad-faced and clean-shaven with thick wavy hair; Caloca, his young assistant, slim with short parted hair. They were killed together at Colotlán on 25 May 1927.
